reasons: The candidate multiplies the result by a numeric constant (100) that does not appear in the Datadog source query sum:nginx.net.reading{$scope}, which the converter rules forbid.

The mapping itself is right: nginx.net.reading is a connection count, and nginx.connections_current with state="reading" measures the same quantity with the same sum aggregation and no extra grouping.
The $scope template variable has no prefix and default '*', so dropping it is correct.
Outcome translated is correct because an exact mapping exists, but the promql must be regenerated without the constant.
